body.text: We have stopped walking. The place is called {param:town}, because somebody had to call it something and I was not quick enough to object.
There is water, and ground that will take a plough, and a great deal of work between here and anything you would call a town.
I have not decided what it is to be for. If you have a view, now is when it will weigh most.

options.text: and am heartily glad of it
and hope the name was the hardest part

steps.prompt: What the new town should be about

options.label: attend to the colony's profit
options.text: Make it pay. A town that pays for itself is a town the Crown leaves alone.

options.label: see that the town grows
options.text: Make it a place people will stay. The rest follows from that.

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: Build the stockade before the houses. You are further out than anyone.

options.label: plant a further settlement
options.text: Do not stop at one. The land beyond you is there for whoever reaches it first.
